title: Item:Sentient Jewel of the Inquisitive
wikitext:
{{Consumable
  | picdesc     = Sentient Jewel of the Inquisitive.png
  | acquired    = <!--Name of NPC-->
  | location    = Ravenloft intro quest reward
  | turnin      = <!-- What is needed to get the item. Leave Blank if None -->
  | minlevel    = 20
  | bind        = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}
  | effect      = A jewel that holds [[Sentient Weapon|sentient power]].
  | cost        = 350 pp
  | weight      = 0.01 lbs
  | stack       = <!-- Stack size for this consumable - default 100 -->
  | description = A jewel that holds sentient power. Click on the Sentient Item button on the right side of the inventory panel (or drag a weapon to that slot) to open the sentient Item panel.
  | notes       = Voiced by [[Keith Silverstein]].
:* On first slotting
:: (Say): "I awaken..."
:: (Say): "Very good"
:* On first equip
:: (Say): "Fate has sent us down this path. Now let's explore it."
:* Random in combat
:: (Say): "Stand in my way, suffer the consequences!"
:: (Say): "Welcome to your doom!"
:: (Say): "Our enemies are destined to fall!"
:* On unequiping
:: (Say): "You will call on me again - and soon."
:* On re-equipping (or logging in)
:: (Say): "Nothing can stand against us - if you follow my instructions."
:: (Say): "You have made a wise decision. Our destiny awaits."
:: (Say): "Together our power will grow."
:* On feeding
:: (Say): "More! Bring me more, so I may fulfill my destiny!"
:* On resurrection
:: (Say): "Back in one piece, are we? Then let's continue."
:* On death
:: (Say): "Perhaps this is where your corpse and my destiny part ways."
:: (Say): "Next time, pay closer attention to my instructions."
:: (Say): "Your flesh is weak. And now it's all over the floor."
:* On party member death
:: (Say): "Next time, try to find us some better help."
:: (Say): "Your friends are careless with their lives."
:: (Say): "They lacked stamina."
:* On shrining
:: (Say): "Rest now, and grow stronger."
:: (Say): "Don't tarry too long. Our destiny awaits."
:: (Say): "Restore your powers so we may claim our rightful destiny."
:* On quest turn-in
:: (Say): "Naturally. We were destined to succeed."
:* On character taking damage 
:: (Say): "Mend yourself. Those wounds are making a mess."
:: (Say): "Ignore your fleshy weakness and concentrate."
:: (Say): "We'll never achieve our destiny this way."
:* On weapon durability loss
:: (Say): "It will take you all night to buff out the dent I just received."
:: (Say): "I'm not meant to take this kind of damage."
:* On incapacitation
:: (Say): "Too bad. And I had such high hopes for you."
:* On recovery after incapacitation
:: (Say): "Finally. Let's get back to it, shall we?"
:* On being hit by a trap
:: (Say): "Watch where you step! I saw that coming a mile away."
:* On opening a chest
:: (Say): "What lies inside? Let me see!"
:: (Say): "Who can say what secrets this contains?"
:: (Say): "This bodes well."
:: (Say): "Fate reveals its hand!"
:: (Say): "Very good."
:: (Say): "Splendid."
:: (Say): "We are destined to succeed!"
:* On casting invisibility upon yourself
:* On accepting a quest
:: (Say): "Fate has sent us down this path. Now let's explore it."
:* On getting turned to stone
:: (Say): "We're not getting anywhere with you in this condition."
:* On red alert
:: (Say): "Pathetic."
:: (Say): "Horrifying."
:* On getting knocked down
:: (Say): "What is wrong with you now?"
:* On gaining a filigree slot
:: (Say): "My knowledge grows. And with it my power."
:* On feeding a sentient spark
:: (Say): "My knowledge grows. And with it my power."
}}
